mc2_15_3.text: Thank you Commander. We sent a demolition team to destroy the enemy's sensor control. Taking down their sensor grid should help your attack. I'll signal them to blow it.

segments: They blew the sensor control, sir. The production facility is virtually blind.
mc2_15_4.text: They blew the sensor control, sir. The production facility is virtually blind.

segments: Welcome mercenary, a real opponent at last. You will make an excellent field test for my legion tanks.
mc2_15_5.text: Welcome mercenary, a real opponent at last. You will make an excellent field test for my legion tanks.

segments: Mercenary Commander, our attack on the Comray has failed. We need assistance. We're dying out here.
mc2_15_6.text: Mercenary Commander, our attack on the Comray has failed. We need assistance. We're dying out here.

segments: Colonel Renard, give me more men. I will personally crush the mercenaries.
Very well, Lord Cho. I will leave this in your hands.
mc2_17_3.text: Colonel Renard, give me more men. I will personally crush the mercenaries. Very well, Lord Cho. I will leave this in your hands.

segments: Do nothing unless I give the order.
mc2_17_8.text: Do nothing unless I give the order.

segments: We will keep an open channel for all parties.
mc2_17_9.text: We will keep an open channel for all parties. Colonel Renard?

segments: Please view it as a show of respect, Lord Cho.
I see you brought your mercenaries.
mc2_17_c.text: Please view it as a show of respect, Lord Cho. I see you brought your mercenaries.

segments: Very well, I will make this quick. We have a mutual enemy. Major Kelly of House Davion.
mc2_17_e.text: Very well, I will make this quick. We have a mutual enemy. Major Kelly of House Davion.

segments: It is therefore in our interest to form an alliance.
mc2_17_f.text: It is therefore in our interest to form an alliance.

segments: However, your actions against House Steiner must have a cost. I'm sure you understand.
mc2_17_h.text: However, your actions against House Steiner must have a cost. I'm sure you understand.

segments: We expect it as much, meaning a price.
mc2_17_i.text: We expect it as much, meaning a price.

segments: That's all? Then the deal is done.
mc2_17_k.text: That's all? Then the deal is done.

segments: We're too late, sir. Steiner and Liao have taken over the city. We'll need to take out whatever forces are stationed here and defeat any reinforcements.
mc2_18_0.text: We're too late, sir. Steiner and Liao have taken over the city. We'll need to take out whatever forces are stationed here and defeat any reinforcements.

segments: So far so good, Commander. You've taken out about half of the enemy, but you'll want to get any repairs done ASAP.
There's another enemy group heading your way and it looks like mostly heavy mechs.
mc2_18_1.text: So far so good, Commander. You've taken out about half of the enemy, but you'll want to get any repairs done ASAP. There's another enemy group heading your way and it looks like mostly heavy mechs.

segments: Good job, sir. You've eliminated about a third of the enemy in this region.
You can extract now, if you want, or keep going and earn some extra C-bills.
mc2_19_0.text: Good job, sir. You've eliminated about a third of the enemy in this region. You can extract now, if you want, or keep going and earn some extra C-bills.

segments: Heads up, sir. It looks like Liao captured the Davion mechs. We'll have to take them out.
mc2_20_0.text: Heads up, sir. It looks like Liao captured the Davion mechs. We'll have to take them out.

segments: About time y'all showed up. Name's Rooster. I've seen action on Port Arthur and Cermak, and I'm itching to shoot something.
What do you say? You got a place for ol' Rooster?
mc2_20_1.text: About time y'all showed up. Name's Rooster. I've seen action on Port Arthur and Cermak, and I'm itching to shoot something. What do you say? You got a place for ol' Rooster?

segments: Sir, I've heard of this guy. He was in Zulu company of the first Davion guards and fought in every major campaign against the Smoke Jaguars. I'll offer him the standard contract with a healthy signing bonus.
mc2_20_2.text: Sir, I've heard of this guy. He was in Zulu company of the first Davion guards and fought in every major campaign against the Smoke Jaguars. I'll offer him the standard contract with a healthy signing bonus.

segments: Attention mercenary! You have disgraced Lady Cho at every turn. We will not allow you to add her palace to your trophy case. Run while you can.
mc2_22.text: Attention mercenary! You have disgraced Lady Cho at every turn. We will not allow you to add her palace to your trophy case. Run while you can.

segments: Thanks for clearing the area. Our team will hold back at the town while you make your way to the starport. We'll follow you in as soon as you engage those bastards.
mc2_23_1.text: Thanks for clearing the area. Our team will hold back at the town while you make your way to the starport. We'll follow you in as soon as you engage those bastards.

segments: Looks like we're gonna have company soon. Check your TAC map.
mc2_23_2.text: Looks like we're gonna have company soon. Check your TAC map.

segments: Uploading data now. Sir, the enemy has an elite group of scout mechs in the area with orders to retake all control buildings.
mc2_23_3.text: Uploading data now. Sir, the enemy has an elite group of scout mechs in the area with orders to retake all control buildings.

segments: We're on our way to the starport now, Commander.
mc2_23_4.text: We're on our way to the starport now, Commander.

segments: This is the Rebel Strike Team Leader. We're breaking free now and on our way to the starport.
mc2_23_5.text: This is the Rebel Strike Team Leader. We're breaking free now and on our way to the starport.

segments: We've captured the eastern turret control. One of the long tom batteries belongs to us now.
mc2_24_3.text: We've captured the eastern turret control. One of the long tom batteries belongs to us now.

segments: We've got the western turret control
mc2_24_4.text: We've got the western turret control

segments: I'm on my way, mercenary. It's a shame that Major Kelly deserted you the way she deserted me. Still, I always knew it would come down to us.
mc2_24_5.text: I'm on my way, mercenary. It's a shame that Major Kelly deserted you the way she deserted me. Still, I always knew it would come down to us.

segments: I don't understand you mercenary. What's the point of earning money if you're not around to spend it?
mc2_24_6.text: I don't understand you mercenary. What's the point of earning money if you're not around to spend it?

segments: Where did you learn to fight? The periphery?
mc2_24_7.text: Where did you learn to fight? The periphery?

segments: Here we go sir. Objective 1 is to investigate an abandoned airfield for bandits. The airfield is located at the number 1 on your tactical map at the lower left of the screen.
tut_1cii.text: Here we go sir. Objective 1 is to investigate an abandoned airfield for bandits. The airfield is located at the number 1 on your tactical map at the lower left of the screen.

segments: Good. Let's do a weapon test before we engage any hostiles.
Order all units to destroy that hangar over there.
tut_1e.text: Good. Let's do a weapon test before we engage any hostiles. Order all units to destroy that hangar over there.

segments: Nice work, Commander. We should repair our units before engaging more enemies.
Check your support tab and call in a repair truck.
Remember that support is limited by our resource points, or RPs, so don't waste them.
tut_1gi.text: Nice work, Commander. We should repair our units before engaging more enemies. Check your support tab and call in a repair truck. Remember that support is limited by our resource points, or RPs, so don't waste them.

segments: Sir, we've got more bandits on the other side of this forest. Even though our line of sight is blocked, we can still detect them using the sensors on our Razorback Scout mech.
tut_1h.text: Sir, we've got more bandits on the other side of this forest. Even though our line of sight is blocked, we can still detect them using the sensors on our Razorback Scout mech.

segments: Here's a good opportunity to salvage an enemy mech, Commander.
Select the salvage craft from our support tab and target a disabled urban mech.
One of our mech warriors will fly in and take control of it.
tut_1hi.text: Here's a good opportunity to salvage an enemy mech, Commander. Select the salvage craft from our support tab and target a disabled urban mech. One of our mech warriors will fly in and take control of it.

segments: Our first objective is to capture that resource building north of our drop zone.
We can use the resource points it gives us to call in support pieces.
tut_3eii.text: Our first objective is to capture that resource building north of our drop zone. We can use the resource points it gives us to call in support pieces.

segments: The best way to deal with bases is to capture the control buildings inside, such as turret controls and gate controls. This will force the gates and turrets to work for us instead of the enemy.
tut_3hi.text: The best way to deal with bases is to capture the control buildings inside, such as turret controls and gate controls. This will force the gates and turrets to work for us instead of the enemy.

segments: This base supports a sensor grid maintained by a sensor control building.
It will allow us to detect any enemies within range of these sensors.
tut_3kii.text: This base supports a sensor grid maintained by a sensor control building. It will allow us to detect any enemies within range of these sensors.

segments: Nice work in securing this area, Commander.
Before we hit the bandits to the north, we might want to scout around for more resource buildings.
tut_3kij.text: Nice work in securing this area, Commander. Before we hit the bandits to the north, we might want to scout around for more resource buildings.

segments: I've taken control of your console for tactical review, sir.
The convoy will be taking this road to the base.
We should take out this military checkpoint and ambush the convoy when they come through here.
Unfortunately, the enemy has set themselves up pretty well.
The turret controls are very well protected.
It'll be tough getting to them without being shot up in the process.
Instead, we can fire at those fuel tanks.
tut_6a.text: I've taken control of your console for tactical review, sir. The convoy will be taking this road to the base. We should take out this military checkpoint and ambush the convoy when they come through here. Unfortunately, the enemy has set themselves up pretty well. The turret controls are very well protected. It'll be tough getting to them without being shot up in the process. Instead, we can fire at those fuel tanks.

segments: Destroying a fuel tank will cause a large explosion, damaging everything within the blast radius.
We can also try shooting those turret generators.
tut_6b.text: Destroying a fuel tank will cause a large explosion, damaging everything within the blast radius. We can also try shooting those turret generators.

segments: That convoy should be here any minute now. Our objective is to capture the HQ vehicle while destroying its guards.
Careful. If the HQ vehicle is destroyed, we fail the mission.
Also, enemy convoys often contain resource trucks. Don't blow them up.
Capturing them gives us resource points just like capturing a resource building, just not as much.
tut_6c.text: That convoy should be here any minute now. Our objective is to capture the HQ vehicle while destroying its guards. Careful. If the HQ vehicle is destroyed, we fail the mission. Also, enemy convoys often contain resource trucks. Don't blow them up. Capturing them gives us resource points just like capturing a resource building, just not as much.

segments: Commander, Steiner just informed me that there's a large bandit force heading our way. We need some support.
Capture any resource buildings in the area. We can use the RPs to call in fixed artillery.
tut_6d.text: Commander, Steiner just informed me that there's a large bandit force heading our way. We need some support. Capture any resource buildings in the area. We can use the RPs to call in fixed artillery.

segments: Fine work, sir. Those hills overlooking the road are excellent ambush points.
Firing from high ground gives us a better chance of hitting an enemy's upper armor and cockpit.
Once you get your mix up on those hills, order them to hold position.
When holding position, pilots will not move unless given a direct order, firing from where they stand.
v6h.text: Fine work, sir. Those hills overlooking the road are excellent ambush points. Firing from high ground gives us a better chance of hitting an enemy's upper armor and cockpit. Once you get your mix up on those hills, order them to hold position. When holding position, pilots will not move unless given a direct order, firing from where they stand.
